args.question: What is the cardholder statement, and which shipments do they say were not received?

args.narrative: All three shipments in this order were delivered: s1 (5652 JPY) by USPS on 2026-01-14, s2 (4503 JPY) and s3 (1298 JPY) by UPS on 2026-01-18. Together they equal the 11453 JPY receipt.

args.explanation: Mastercard 4855 goods-not-provided chargeback for 11453 JPY across three shipments. The case file had the receipt and a carrier delivery proof for each shipment (s1 USPS 2026-01-14, s2 and s3 UPS 2026-01-18), covering the full amount. Represented with the receipt, the three delivery proofs and the authorization record. The issuer accepted the representment and the case resolved in the merchant favour; the chargeback amount was returned and only the 15.00 USD chargeback fee remains as cost. No documents uploaded.
